title: P1 Stealth & Evasion Specification
description: Four stealth modules integrated into CapabilityBroker authorization flow without modifying D-Series core.

SS-01_ScopeParser.description: HackerOne JSON/Markdown scope parsing, wildcard domains, CIDR, exclusions, URL-path prefixes, fail-closed

SS-02_RateLimiter.description: Per-target + global rate tracking, configurable jitter (5-15s), emergency brake, shell keepalive, async-safe

SS-03_WAFDetector.description: 7 WAF signatures (Cloudflare, ModSecurity, AWS WAF, F5 ASM, Akamai, Sucuri, Wordfence), benign probe fingerprinting, 5-min TTL cache

SS-04_PayloadMutator.description: 7 deterministic mutations (case, comment, encoding, whitespace, unicode, param pollution, boundary) + LLM fuzzing, WAF-specific strategy maps, max 3 rounds

integration.capability_broker: Accepts optional rate_limiter, scope_parser, payload_mutator, student instances
integration.authorization_flow: RateLimiter delay in ALLOW path; ScopeParser delegation in _run_all_checks; PayloadMutator + Student in resolve_falsification
integration.student_integration: StudentCandidateGenerator.generate_candidates(waf_info) tags candidates with waf_type, waf_confidence, adjusted confidence

safety_invariants: RateLimiter emergency brake: anomaly threshold → halt all actions
ShellKeepAlive: heartbeat bypasses RateLimiter, sends raw \n to PTY
PayloadMutator max 3 rounds; LLM mutation method 8/8, experimental
